name: IRON BOND FABRICATION
old_description: Stainless process piping, food-grade equipment, structural steel and mobile
about:
Iron Bond Fabrication is a family-run welding and fabrication shop based in Springdale, Arkansas. The company operates a fabrication shop and a mobile service truck, serving plants, contractors, and property owners across Northwest Arkansas.

The shop focuses on four core areas: sanitary and food-grade welding for process piping, tanks, hoppers, and blenders used in food and beverage plants and breweries; structural steel fabrication of platforms, mezzanines, stair towers, catwalks, and equipment frames; mobile welding that brings on-site repair and fabrication to the customer's plant or job site; and custom one-off metalwork such as gates, railing, brackets, trailers, and prototypes built from drawings, photos, or rough sketches. Work is performed in a small shop facility with a service truck for field jobs.

Customers include food and beverage processors, breweries, general contractors, maintenance departments, and property owners throughout Northwest Arkansas. The company has worked with firms such as Tidey Excavation and handles projects that must accommodate production schedules, sanitation windows, and plant shutdowns.

Iron Bond emphasizes that the person who quotes a job is the person who welds it, ensuring no loss of detail between estimate and finished part. The company highlights proper fit-up, purge, and heat control on every weld, straight answers on schedule and price with early notice of changes, experience working inside operating facilities, and a policy of leaving the job site as clean as they found it.
